def compute_cost(n, i):
    total_cost = i * (n // ones[i])
    n %= ones[i]

    cost_option1 = i + compute_cost(ones[i] - n, i - 1)
    cost_option2 = compute_cost(n, i - 1)
    return total_cost + min(cost_option1, cost_option2)
